roemerberg.name: Römerberg
roemerberg.slogan: Gabled facades where emperors once feasted on roast ox.
roemerberg.line: Between 1562 and 1792 the square hosted ten imperial coronation festivals, each with an ox kitchen in the open air.

maintower.name: Main Tower
maintower.slogan: Frankfurt's skyline from the only high-rise you can climb.
maintower.line: It is the only skyscraper in Frankfurt with a public viewing observatory; the roof stands at 200 metres.

kaiserdom.name: Kaiserdom
kaiserdom.slogan: A red sandstone tower that watched emperors being crowned.
kaiserdom.line: Emperors were elected here from 1356, and from 1562 to 1792 they were crowned beneath its 95-metre tower.

mathildenhoehe.name: Mathildenhöhe
mathildenhoehe.slogan: A hilltop where artists built a whole utopia in 1899.
mathildenhoehe.line: My Hessian land shall flourish and in it, art.
mathildenhoehe.by: Grand Duke Ernst Ludwig of Hesse, motto of the Darmstadt artists' colony

grubemessel.name: Messel Pit
grubemessel.slogan: An old oil-shale pit that keeps 47-million-year-old secrets.
grubemessel.line: Its Eocene fossils are about 47 million years old, and a planned landfill was stopped before it became a World Heritage Site in 1995.
